name: Takane Michiko
source:
Michiko is also in [url=/c10778]Mizuho[/url]'s class and is a good friend of [url=/c10802]Kei[/url]'s as they are constantly seen hanging out together. Unlike Kei, Michiko usually has a smile on her face and is a fairly social person.

Voiced by: Hina Kamimura (PC), Yukari Fukui (PS2/PSP)

[Taken from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Otome_wa_Boku_ni_Koishiteru_characters]Wikipedia[/url].]
